chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Ali from his father from Hammad from Hariz from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Every garment in which one prays, there is no harm in entering into the state of Ihram while wearing it."

key_terms.يُحْرَمَ: to enter the state of Ihram (consecration)

ai.seo_question: What type of clothing is permissible for entering the state of Ihram during Hajj?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishing a permissive ruling (*la ba'sa*) that any garment valid for prayer is also permissible for Ihram, reflecting the Shia principle of general permissibility (*al-asl fi al-thiyab al-ibaha*) unless specific prohibitions apply. This hadith simplifies the pilgrim's preparation by linking the sanctity of prayer garments to the sacred state of consecration, avoiding unnecessary restrictions on fabric or style.
